formulas.actual: Actual Cost net = original recognized project costs ± post-close month-close corrections (once), excluding VAT. Families, vendor bills, and labor are the original recognized amount. Drafts and open POs stay out.
formulas.forecast: Forecast Final Cost net = Actual net + remaining PO commitments + expected remaining cost (ETC). Open AP payable is cash-only disclosure.
formulas.current_contract: Current Contract net = original managed value ± approved additions/reductions, excluding VAT. Pending changes stay out.
formulas.actual_margin: Actual profit net = Current Contract net - Actual Cost net. Not an invoice total.
formulas.forecast_margin: Forecast profit net = Current Contract net - Forecast Final Cost net. Not an invoice total.
formulas.unallocated_cost: Unallocated general business costs await allocation - counted in organization expense totals, never forced into project Actual or profit.
formulas.outstanding_ar: Outstanding to collect = Invoice total - Paid - held retainage. Forecast collection, not profit.
formulas.outstanding_ap: Outstanding AP = unmatched open vendor bills payable. Cash obligation disclosure - not Actual Cost.
